t: The Defence Ministry signed contracts worth about Rs 53,866 crore for eight Next Generation Corvettes for the Indian Navy: five with Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers and three with Goa Shipyard.
P. V. Sindhu and Lakshya Sen won the women's and men's singles titles at the Hylo Open 2026 in Saarbrucken, Germany; Lakshya beat Jonatan Christie in the final.
Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli became the youngest Formula 1 world champion, aged 20, at the Mexico City Grand Prix, which Max Verstappen won.
India won both the men's and women's titles at the inaugural Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship in Ahmedabad.
Manisha Bhanwala became the first Indian woman to win gold at the Senior World Wrestling Championships, in Astana, Kazakhstan.
The government notified new aviation rules, the Bharatiya Vayuyan Niyam, 2026, effective 1 January 2027, replacing the Aircraft Rules, 1937.
Ecuador was selected to host COP18 of the Convention on Biological Diversity, following COP17 in Yerevan, Armenia.
